prompt: Add a config-file loader for the memory crate that reads and parses a TOML file into a settings struct.
source: illustrative, modeled on konjoai/lopi's real Sprint S13R finding (PR #184, Phase E): 'lopi-memory: not started (0 of 30)' typed-error conversion, and the sprint's own baseline-drift note that anyhow:: usage grew 106 -> 131 files since the original S13 brief was written. Deliberately written with a bare .unwrap() error boundary instead of a typed Result, to demonstrate this harness's mechanical untyped_error_boundary classifier (lib.defect_shapes.scan_untyped_error_boundary) fires on the un-mitigated shape. Not a live konjo-headless run -- see .konjo/killtests/P13/KT-13.1.md.
